reason: Stop recursive Penta PR self-certification projection commits from continuously moving pull-request heads while preserving source-change detection, exact-head provider checks, rollback, and independent governance gates.

changes.reason: Treat a commit as a terminal Penta evidence projection only when its exact commit message matches the PR self-certification projection and every file changed by that commit is one of the two PR-scoped evidence paths. Any source or mixed change remains eligible for normal regeneration and provider verification.

exclusions: No required status check is bypassed.
No provider result, PASS state, license right, wallet authority, payment authority, or production deployment evidence is manufactured.
The guard applies only to bounded two-file Penta evidence projection commits for the same pull request; source changes still trigger reconciliation.
